operators.name: group_norm_forward
semantics: Applies GroupNorm with num_groups=16, channels=16, eps as passed.
For each sample and group, normalize over (C/G, H, W) elements using mean and variance; then affine with weight and bias per channel.
Input x must be contiguous float32 CUDA tensor with shape [N, C, H, W].
Weight and bias must be contiguous float32 CUDA tensors with shape [C].
Output shape equals input shape [N, C, H, W].

operators.name: log_softmax_dim1_forward
semantics: Computes log_softmax over dimension 1 for a 4D tensor [N, C, H, W].
For each (n, h, w) position, reduces over the C dimension, computing log(sum(exp(x))) and subtracts it from each element.
Input must be contiguous float32 CUDA tensor.
Output shape equals input shape [N, C, H, W].
Calls self.group_norm with default arguments; group_norm is nn.GroupNorm(16,16,eps=1e-5, affine=True).
Output is GroupNorm result with same shape.
Computes log_softmax along dimension 1 (channels) for the normalized tensor.
Returns the final log_softmax output tensor.
